Risk, in plain words Is there risk with JetUP and TAG Markets? Yes, like any trading. Prices move both ways, and 24x Amplify makes every move bigger. That's why the plan starts small ($50 into Sonic AI), and a built-in loss limit closes the account at 10% of the starting balance (5% with a community token), so you know the line before you start. What is Amplify 24x? Amplify lets the account trade at 24 times its size: $50 trades like $1,200. That is , the size you trade with, not money you own. A drop of about 4.2% on the trading balance is the same size as the whole account. Watch the 2:13 explainer . When is an account closed (liquidated)? It's written on TAG Markets' screen: the account closes if the trader's loss passes 10% of the starting balance. With a community token, that limit becomes 5%. So you know the line before you start. t: A trades, and its trades are copied into your own account automatically. Think of a cooking class where the chef's every step happens in your own pot: your pot, your ingredients, your name on it. On CopyX the chef is and the pot is your account at TAG Markets. Watch the 2:04 explainer .

h: Is TAG Markets regulated in South Africa?
t: TAG Markets' trading company, T.M. Financials Ltd, is licensed by the FSC in Mauritius (GB21026474). In South Africa, TM Financials SA (Pty) Ltd is authorised by the , FSP 55237, for marketing services. You can look both up yourself: check 2 .

h: I lost money in other programs. Why is this different?
t: You're right to be careful, and MTG has been there too. Most bad programs ask you to send money to them and promise a fixed return. Here your money goes into your own account at a licensed broker, the strategy's record is public, no return is promised, and you can watch every trade and withdraw yourself. Check it, then start small.

h: How much can I earn? Is there a daily return?
t: There is no fixed, daily or guaranteed return, and anyone who promises one is a red flag. When the strategy makes a profit, 70% of it is yours, and when it doesn't, there is no fee. Look at Sonic AI's record on Myfxbook and try your own numbers in the Profit Split Calculator .

h: How much do I need to start?
t: The training uses $155 in or USDC: $50 into Sonic AI, $100 left in your balance for the Dennis promo, and a few dollars spare. Keep a little extra on the exchange for the fee, and start with an amount you're comfortable with.

h: I've never bought crypto. Can I still start?
t: Yes. You fund your account with USDT or USDC, digital dollars you buy on an exchange such as VALR or Binance, and send them to your TAG Markets account on the same network. Part 4 shows every tap.

h: Which network should I use for the TAG Markets deposit?
t: In this order: USDT on BEP20 (BNB Smart Chain) first, USDT on TRC20 (Tron) second, and USDC on ERC20 (Ethereum) if you prefer it, which is the most expensive. Use the same network on both sides, so your funds arrive safely.

h: Which exchange or wallet should I use?
t: VALR first, Binance second, or a Web3 wallet such as SafePal or MetaMask. The VALR and Binance buttons on this site are MTG's referral links.

The Sonic AI strategy has no management fee and no join fee. Its only fee is 30% of profit, and only when it makes a profit. Sending crypto costs a small network fee, and withdrawal fees and limits are the broker's terms.

When the strategy makes a profit, 70% is yours and 30% is the , which pays the broker, the strategy provider and the partner program. There is no performance fee on a loss, and no management or join fee. Watch the 70/30 explainer .

h: Can I take my own money out of the strategy?
t: Yes. Profits can be withdrawn any time. Your own capital has a one month minimum on Sonic AI (the CopyX terms): give the strategy at least a month with your full amount, and after that you can take it out. To stop a strategy, open CopyX, Follower Hub, Strategies and tap the red square next to Withdraw. With the Dennis promo, taking your own $100 out before 12 months ends the promo.

Profits can be withdrawn any time, through the broker. JetUP's one-pager says withdrawals take about 48 hours on average. With the Dennis promo, taking your own money out before 12 months ends the promo. Test a small withdrawal early. Watch the 2:06 explainer .

h: Do I have to recruit people to earn?
t: No. As a client you earn from your own strategy: when Sonic AI makes a profit, 70% of it is yours, and you never have to refer anyone. A website that publishes trading results, so you can look at a strategy's record before you deposit.
The blockchain route a coin travels on, for example Tron (TRC20). The sending side and the receiving side must use the same network.

The 30% of strategy profit that pays the broker, the strategy provider and the partner program. It is only taken from profits.
The secret words that restore a self-custody wallet. Write them down offline and never share them with anyone.
You hold the keys to your own crypto wallet, so only you can move the funds.

Digital dollars (stablecoins) that you send from an exchange to fund your TAG Markets account.
